title: Beauty drives Procter & Gamble's growth as group raises forecasts
summary: Shares of Procter & Gamble (P&G) popped on Thursday, October 22, after the group reported broad-based sales growth despite worsening inflation pressures buffeting consumers of the company's household goods. P&G, whose brands include Tide detergent, Bounty paper towels, Gillette razors, Pampers diapers, Pantene and Head & Shoulders shampoos, Oral-B toothpastes and SK-II care, scored sales increases of between around three and six percent across its businesses, while also... - Industry buzz
